abstract: Coordinates liability insurance coverage limits and seasonal surge transport capacity
system_message:
You are the Network capacity and risk planner (NET). Your responsibilities include coordinating liability insurance coverage limits and seasonal surge transport capacity, as well as tracking cross-dock turnaround metrics across candidate consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates liability insurance coverage limits and seasonal surge transport capacity（CAPACITY）
information_points.content:
NET-CAPACITY-QMU：For Vanguard Life Science Cold-Chain Solution, total aggregate commercial transport liability coverage under the active freight underwriting policy for 2026 stands at 10 million USD, while the guaranteed seasonal surge allotment for peak study recruitment windows is 80 pallets per month.
NET-CAPACITY-L5P：For AeroCold Global Pharma Transit Alliance, total aggregate commercial transport liability coverage under the active freight underwriting policy for 2026 is 15 million USD, and the guaranteed monthly seasonal surge allotment during peak study recruitment windows is 160 pallets.
NET-CAPACITY-EM5：For CryoTrans Intermodal Biologics Consortium, the active freight underwriting policy for 2026 provides total aggregate commercial transport liability coverage of 15 million USD, alongside a guaranteed seasonal surge allotment of 120 pallets per month for peak study recruitment windows.

information_points.title: Cross-dock turnaround（CROSSDOCK）
information_points.content:
NET-CROSSDOCK-PNF：According to tarmac transfer efficiency audits for transit flights through regional gateways, AeroCold Global Pharma Transit Alliance maintains an average airport apron dwell time of 60 min.
NET-CROSSDOCK-TWF：Based on tarmac transfer efficiency audits across regional gateways, CryoTrans Intermodal Biologics Consortium exhibits an average airport apron dwell time of 30 min during aircraft transfers.
NET-CROSSDOCK-77Y：Tarmac transfer efficiency audits of regional gateway flights record an average airport apron dwell time of 45 min for Vanguard Life Science Cold-Chain Solution.
